## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New behavior has a test
- [ ] `dist/` is rebuilt and committed
- [ ] Write tools still require an explicit `account`; no tokens or secrets in output or logs
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code (no new dependencies without discussion)
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] Docs updated if tools, the CLI, or configuration changed
